2.Wi-Fi

Wi-Fi can be enabled to automatically search for available Wi-Fi hotspots. Select the 
desired Wi-Fi network and enter the password to connect. After a successful connection, 
Wi-Fi will automatically reconnect when enabled again.  

Wi-Fi can also be toggled in the Control Centre using the Wi-Fi buttonńshort press to 
turn Wi-Fi on/off, long press to enter the Wi-Fi settings list. 

Supports enterprise Wi-Fi connection.
3. Bluetooth 

Enable Bluetooth to search for nearby available Bluetooth devices and send connection 
requests. Both devices must be paired for Bluetooth to function.  

Bluetooth can also be toggled in the Control Center using the Bluetooth buttonńshort 
press to turn Bluetooth on/off, long press to enter the Bluetooth settings list. 

Supports file transfer via Bluetooth. Transferred files can be accessed under "Received 
Files."
4. Language 

Supports language selection, including English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, 
Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.

Automatically adapts date formats according to the selected language.

File Encryption
Select Files to Encrypt or Decrypt
File encryption is available in both the Paper and Meeting modules. Long press a file to enter edit mode 
and apply encryption to one or multiple files. You may also click the encryption icon within the file 
toolbar to secure the current file. To remove encryption, click the icon again and enter the password. For 
user privacy, encryption is not linked to any account.
Set Encryption Password
When using the document encryption feature for the 
first time, you must set an encryption password. 
Passwords for Paper and Meeting are managed 
independently, although identical passwords may be set. 
Passwords must be 4–12 characters in length. 
Fingerprint access for encrypted files is also supported 
and can be enabled manually under [Settings] – 
[Security] – [Fingerprint].
Change Encryption 
Password
To change the encryption password, 
tap the encrypted file and select 
the password change option on the 
input screen.
Note: Passwords are stored locally 
on the device. Please remember 
your password, as files cannot be 
unlocked if it is forgotten.

text:
AI
This is an intelligent sheet of paper. It allows interaction with AI and provides context-
specific AI assistance in various modules. AI functions are available even when not logged 
in. Supported models include GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Deepseek-R1, and Deepseek-V1.
Voice AI, Text Entry via Electronic Keyboard
Long press the AI button on the bottom right corner of the e-ink tablet to record a voice message 
up to 15 seconds. Release to automatically send it to AI, which will transcribe the voice message 
into text. The AI has strong reasoning abilities to address everyday issues encountered in life and 
learning. AI endows our future paper with limitless intelligence.
